comment.body: Thanks for the MWB log and for confirming this persisted through 0.98.1. The linked settings-save PR does not prove it covers your disconnect. Could you confirm whether the same two-PC loss still occurs on current latest stable and which PC first shows the disconnect? If it still reproduces, please comment `/bugreport` immediately after one failure on both PCs and include the approximate time. This will show whether the settings/reconnect path is involved or the peers fail independently.
